readthrough.title: What the completed session can and cannot show
readthrough.body: Across these twelve companies, the daily bars establish price, range and volume for November 2. The research log records no verified company-specific event for this edition; Tuesday earnings and later filings will test the investment cases.

headline: Monday November 2 close: measured AI and growth repricing
quick: The twelve tracked stocks finished November 2 with measured moves; the largest measured changes were AMZN +2.20% and MRVL -12.72%.

macro.dd: The twelve company moves below come solely from validated completed Twelve Data daily bars. Earnings and macro releases provide dated context, but a headline does not prove the cause of a measured move.

entries.happened: AAPL closed the completed November 2, 2026 NYSE session at $338.32, -1.83% versus the prior close of $344.63. The session ranged from $335.82 to $343.80, with volume of 63,842,300 shares versus a trailing average of 40,410,695. No verified company-specific event was found for AAPL in the dated sources checked for this edition.
entries.figures: Close $338.32 Prior close $344.63 Change -1.83% Volume 63,842,300 vs average 40,410,695
entries.why: The measured down move is evidence about trading, not a diagnosis of the business. For AAPL, the next investment test is whether operating results, cash generation, competitive position and valuation support the share price as rates and AI capital spending evolve. Volume relative to its trailing average provides a participation check, but it cannot identify who traded or why. The November 2 tape should be tested against subsequent filings, guidance and follow-through rather than treated as proof of causation.
